quarterly_data.signal: IFRS 2026 Semi Annual Report (six months ended June 27, 2026): first-half revenues were $6,582 million, up 24.6% versus the first half of 2025, as a result of an approximate 5% increase in average selling prices (more favorable product mix) and an increase in volumes of approximately 20%; by segment AM&S +24.6%, P&D +1.1%, EMP +33.5% and RFOC +32.9%. Revenues by region of shipment: Asia Pacific $4,140 million (vs $3,255 million), EMEA $1,506 million (vs $1,123 million), Americas $936 million (vs $905 million). Purchases of subcontracting services rose to $986 million from $727 million and purchases of materials to $1,376 million from $1,213 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenues $6,582 million (+24.6%): ASP ~+5%, volumes ~+20%; subcontracting services $986 million (vs $727 million)
